fieldNotes.siteResolution: Given coords (29.5605,-95.1167) were ~17 km off, landing on apartment/retail blocks. ROOFTOP geocode of '2818 Pasadena Fwy, Pasadena TX 77506' returns 29.7106063,-95.1750066, which lands on a large modern white-roof distribution building fronting TX-225 (Pasadena Fwy). Address confirmed as the BlueTriton/Primo (Ozarka/Pure Life) Pasadena bottling-distribution site; the ~403,000 SF building is now operated/tenanted by Keller Logistics (3PL) per LoopNet/Keller location pages. Center locked at 29.71020,-95.17450 (center of the building footprint).
fieldNotes.truckGate: FALSE - high confidence. Two open sweeping driveways connect the property to the TX-225 frontage road (one at the NW serving the truck/dock side, one at the NE serving the office/car entrance). Street View (Feb 2025 + Apr 2026 panos) along the frontage road shows NO barrier arm, NO sliding/swing gate, and NO perimeter fence across either entrance - the frontage is open grass/landscaping straight to the building. Open spec-DC entry.
fieldNotes.guardShack: FALSE - high confidence. No booth-sized structure (1-3 vehicle footprint, multi-side windows) at either driveway in satellite or in the two frontage-road Street View frames. Only a monument sign near the NW entrance.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: FALSE - there is no truck gate, so remote-gatehouse/kiosk does not apply.
fieldNotes.truckGateCount: Counted as 2 open vehicular entrances off the frontage road (NW truck/dock entry + NE office/main entry), neither controlled.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Banded 25-50. Main dock bank runs the full WEST wall (~270 m, regular leveler/bay rhythm with several trailers backed in, z19/z20 west-apron crops); a second dock bank runs the SOUTH face with trailer-parking striping on its apron. North face has a smaller dock cluster near the office. Honest total estimate ~45 across faces; sits near the 25-50 / 50+ boundary - banded 25-50 conservatively given roof glare softens the count.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Banded 10-25. Striped trailer-parking stalls visible on the south apron and the NE apron; only ~12 trailers actually parked in the captured imagery, but marked capacity reads ~15-25. Drop area present but lightly occupied at capture time.
fieldNotes.dropYard: TRUE - the south apron functions as a dedicated striped trailer-storage/drop lot distinct from the active west dock staging.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: TRUE (medium confidence) - docks sit on two physically separate building faces (long west bank + south bank), consistent with split ship/receive in a cross-dock layout; function cannot be confirmed from imagery.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: TRUE - the wide west apron and the NE apron between the entrance and the dock faces act as internal queue/staging space inside the property.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: TRUE - the perimeter truck drive wraps the west and south faces with a deep apron easily holding 3+ trucks queued before the docks.
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: TRUE (medium confidence) - two distinct driveways at different points of the north property line (NW truck entry, NE office entry) read as separate in/out points; could also be used as a loop.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: TRUE - very wide unused paved apron width on the west and north sides plus two open ungated entrances leave ample room to stripe an express/bypass check-in lane.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Estimated 1 controlled inbound lane equivalent per driveway (uncontrolled open drives); low confidence.
